enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan on low to cope with the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket. Turn to left side. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep. Turn to back. Adjust fan direction. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Splash water on face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put toothbrush down. Pick up clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a quick breakfast and drinking water before the hot day ahead
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out cereal box. Close cabinet. Take out bowl. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Stir cereal. Eat cereal. Pick up glass. Fill glass with water. Drink water. Put bowl and glass in sink. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, checking phone for shift messages and doing a final uniform check
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up work bag. Open bag. Put stethoscope in bag. Put notebook in bag. Put pen in bag. Put water bottle in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Press button. Swipe screen. Open messaging app. Read messages. Close app. Put phone in pocket. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Straighten name badge. Pick up bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient care, ward rounds, medication administration and clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Put bag in locker. Wash hands. Attend handover meeting. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Assist patient with walking. Respond to call bell. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to ward. Continue patient care. Handover to next shift. Change out of scrubs. Walk to exit.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the shift, keeping hydrated in the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Buy water bottle. Drink water. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Drink water. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after returning home
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Splash water on face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Close cabinet. Turn on stove. Add oil to pot. Chop vegetables. Put vegetables in pot. Stir. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Put plate in sink. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes, wiping benches and putting leftovers in the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place in dish rack. Wash utensils. Rinse. Place in rack. Wash pot. Rinse. Place in rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Open refrigerator. Take out containers. Put leftovers in containers. Close containers. Place containers in refrigerator. Close refrigerator. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing into light sleepwear
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature to cool. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Lather. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out sleepwear. Put on sleepwear. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing, using the fan instead of the air-conditioner to avoid the evening peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get water. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off fan. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for light browsing, reviewing tomorrow's roster and reading under the desk lamp with the fan running
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on fan. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for startup. Open browser. Browse websites. Open email. Check roster. Close browser. Open document. Read. Turn page. Close laptop. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Close book. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off fan. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Going to bed and sleeping with the fan on for ventilation during the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn on fan. Set fan to low. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Wake briefly. Adjust fan direction. Sleep. Turn to back. Pull blanket up. Sleep.
